'''Naomi''' (Japanese: '''ナルミ''' ''Narumi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP257|Lapras of Luxury]]''. She is a Pokémon researcher studying communication between {{type|Water}} Pokémon, specifically {{p|Lapras}}. She is the director and sole employee of the [[Marine Pokémon Laboratory]].

She was studying the [[Lapras herd]] that [[Ash's Lapras]] belonged to. Thanks to {{Ash}} and his Lapras, Naomi was able to discover that the herd came from the [[Orange Islands]], something she hadn't known before.

After {{TRT}} had netted the Lapras herd, Naomi ordered Ash and {{ashfr}} into her submarine, the S.S. Innocent Coral, to follow after them. She used Ash's Lapras's own singing to track the caught herd, which led her to a wall of riptides and later an island where Team Rocket had stopped to catch their breaths. While [[Brock's Crobat]] dealt with Team Rocket's Pokémon, Naomi helped free the Lapras from the capture net.

Later, Naomi reported back to [[Professor Elm]] that Ash's contributions will help her to complete her thesis on Lapras migration patterns. She handed Ash the [[Pokémon Egg]] to be delivered to Elm before they left her lab.
